step1_analysis.description: A two-input common-source amplifier with a diode-connected PMOS active load. It functions as a low-impedance summing node or a low-gain, high-bandwidth pre-amplifier stage, commonly used in current-mode signal processing or comparators.

power.description: Total static power consumption of the circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: With inputs at 0.9V, NMOS Vov = 0.48V. PMOS diode load forces output to ~0.32V, putting NMOS in triode. Id_total ≈ 280 uA. Power = 1.8V * 280uA = 0.5 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 parameters and the provided 0.9V DC bias, adjusting for the triode region operation of the NMOS.

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain from one input to the output

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain ≈ gm_n / gm_p. In triode, gm_n ≈ un*Cox*(W/L)*Vds ≈ 0.86 mA/V. gm_p ≈ 1.06 mA/V. Gain ≈ 0.81 V/V or -1.8 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The diode-connected load provides a low impedance (1/gm_p), resulting in a low voltage gain typical for current-summing nodes.

sky130_expected.calculation: Pole ≈ gm_p / (2 * pi * C_node). With gm_p ≈ 1 mA/V and parasitic capacitance ~50 fF, bandwidth is roughly 3 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The low impedance of the diode-connected load pushes the dominant pole to very high frequencies, well above the 100 MHz operating speed of the full comparator.

v_out_dc.description: DC operating voltage at the output node

sky130_expected.calculation: Equating NMOS triode current and PMOS saturation current yields Vds ≈ 0.32V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The strong PMOS load (W/L=20 total) pulls the output voltage down until the NMOS enters the triode region to balance the currents.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point, power consumption, low-frequency gain, and bandwidth of the summing amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Summing Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 N0 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9 ac 1
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 0.9

.control
  * DC Operating Point Analysis
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  print v(N0)
  let v_out_dc = v(N0)

  * AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
  ac dec 100 1k 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(N0)
  meas ac dc_gain_db find gain_db at=1k
  let f3db_mag = dc_gain_db - 3
  meas ac bandwidth when gain_db=f3db_mag fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
